Zoning and Neighborhood Air Quality: Evidence from HOLC Boundaries
abstract: We examine whether contemporary land-use regulation is associated with disparities in air pollution exposure across neighborhoods in 37 major U.S. cities. Our contribution is to identify a durable institutional mechanism through which historical neighborhood classifications continue to shape the spatial distribution of environmental quality. Because zoning is endogenous to neighborhood amenities and historical development patterns, we instrument for present-day zoning using historical Home Owners' Loan Corporation (HOLC) neighborhood grades. To isolate the regulatory legacy of HOLC assessments from pre-existing urban geography, we control extensively for historical manufacturing activity, transportation networks, built-environment characteristics, and pollution-related nuisances documented in HOLC records. The first stage is strong and monotonic: historically lower-graded neighborhoods are substantially more likely to permit multi-family residential development today. Our preferred 2SLS estimates indicate that areas permitting multi-family housing experience approximately 1.1 µg/m 3 higher annual PM 2.5 exposure, equivalent to 13 percent of the sample mean. Mechanism evidence suggests that multi-family residential areas are systematically located closer to commercial and industrial land uses, consistent with a spatial configuration in which exclusionary zoning separates singlefamily neighborhoods from pollution-generating activities. These findings suggest that local land-use institutions not only shape housing markets and segregation but also govern the longrun allocation of environmental amenities and burdens across urban space.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在美国37个主要城市中，当代土地利用管制是否与各社区之间空气污染暴露的差异有关。我们的贡献在于识别出一种持久的制度机制，通过这一机制，历史上的社区分类持续塑造着环境质量的空间分布。由于分区管制与社区舒适性及历史发展模式相互内生，我们使用历史上房主贷款公司（HOLC）的社区等级作为当代分区管制的工具变量。为将HOLC评估的管制遗产与既有城市地理区分开来，我们广泛控制了历史上的制造业活动、交通网络、建成环境特征，以及HOLC记录中所记载的污染相关妨害。第一阶段结果强烈且单调：历史上评级较低的社区，如今更有可能允许多户住宅开发。我们偏好的两阶段最小二乘估计表明，允许建设多户住房的地区，其年均PM2.5暴露约高出1.1 µg/m³，相当于样本均值的13%。机制证据表明，多户住宅区系统性地更靠近商业和工业用地，这与一种空间配置相一致：排他性分区将独户住宅社区与产生污染的活动隔离开来。这些发现表明，地方土地利用制度不仅塑造了住房市场和居住隔离，还支配着城市空间中环境舒适性与负担的长期分配。

title: The Impact of Air Pollution on Labor Supply in China
abstract: A growing literature demonstrates that air pollution has negative impacts on human health, cognitive ability, and labor productivity, but little is known about the effect of chronic air pollution on labor supply decisions. We use restricted-access individual-level panel data from the China Family Panel Survey (CFPS), paired with sub-district level remote-sensing estimates of air pollution, to evaluate the impact of chronic exposure to fine particulate matter PM2.5 on an individual's hours worked. We exploit within-individual changes in air pollution, and fixed effects estimates indicate that an increase of 1 μg/m3 in PM2.5 reduces an individual's average hours worked by about 14 minutes per week. We then leverage the staggered, city-level roll-out of air pollution monitoring and information provision to test hypotheses about the underlying mechanisms. We show that individuals with poor health are the most responsive to changes in PM2.5. For individuals who are environmentally 'unaware', this effect is mostly through an impact of pollution on health, while individuals who claim to be 'environmentally-aware' engage in avoidance behavior. Finally, the roll-out of monitoring and information provision at the city level plays an important role in raising awareness and individuals' responsiveness to pollution.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献表明，空气污染会对人体健康、认知能力和劳动生产率产生负面影响，但人们对慢性空气污染如何影响劳动供给决策知之甚少。我们使用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）的受限访问个人层面面板数据，并配以街道层面的遥感空气污染估计值，评估慢性暴露于细颗粒物PM2.5对个人工作时长的影响。我们利用个体内部的空气污染变化，固定效应估计表明，PM2.5每增加1 μg/m³，个人平均每周工作时长减少约14分钟。随后，我们利用城市层面空气污染监测与信息发布的交错推广，检验关于潜在机制的假设。我们发现，健康状况较差的个人对PM2.5变化的反应最为敏感。对于“环境意识淡薄”的个人，这一效应主要通过污染对健康的影响而发生；而自称“具有环境意识”的个人则采取规避行为。最后，城市层面监测与信息发布的推行，在提高公众意识以及个人对污染的反应方面发挥了重要作用。

venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_zh: 衡量捕食者所带来的经济效益十分困难，因为其影响往往是间接的，并通过复杂的生态变化而发生。因此，关于扩大捕食者种群的争论，常常将显著的成本与较为推测性的效益估计相对立，而后者可能被视为不可靠或出于意识形态动机而遭到摒弃。我们量化了狼（Canis lupus）通过减少鹿与车辆碰撞，为人类生命和财产带来的间接效益。此外，我们将该效应分解为两个组成部分：猎物行为的变化与猎物数量的变化。当有效的政策取决于猎人能否复制捕食者的作用时，这一分解尤为重要。就狼而言，我们的结论是：人类猎鹿者无法做到这一点。

Fossil Fuel Subsidy Reform in the Developing World: Who Wins, Who Loses, and Why?
abstract: Fossil fuel subsidies are widespread in developing countries, where reform efforts are often derailed by disputes over the likely distribution of gains and losses. The impacts of subsidy reform are transmitted to households through changes in energy prices and prices of other goods and services, as well as through factor earnings. Most empirical studies focus on consumer expenditures alone, and computable general equilibrium analyses typically report only total effects without decomposing them by source. Meanwhile, analytical models neglect important open-economy characteristics relevant to developing countries. In this paper, we develop an analytical model of a small open economy with a preexisting fossil fuel subsidy and identify direct and indirect impacts of subsidy reform on real household incomes. Our results, illustrated with data from Viet Nam, highlight two important drivers of distributional change: (i) the mix of tradable and nontradable goods, reflecting the structure of a trade-dependent economy; and (ii) household heterogeneity in sources of factor income.
abstract_zh: 化石燃料补贴在发展中国家十分普遍，而改革努力常因对收益与损失可能分配状况的争议而受阻。补贴改革的影响通过能源价格以及其他商品和服务价格的变化，以及要素收入，传导至家庭。大多数实证研究仅关注消费者支出，而可计算一般均衡分析通常只报告总效应，而不按来源加以分解。与此同时，分析模型忽视了与发展中国家相关的重要开放经济特征。在本文中，我们构建了一个存在既有化石燃料补贴的小型开放经济分析模型，并识别了补贴改革对家庭实际收入的直接和间接影响。我们以越南的数据加以说明，结果突出了收入分配变化的两个重要驱动因素：（i）可贸易品与不可贸易品的构成，这反映了依赖贸易的经济结构；以及（ii）家庭在要素收入来源上的异质性。

title: Property Rights, Regulatory Capture, and Exploitation of Natural Resources
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We study how the strength of property rights to individual extractive firms affects a regulator's choice over exploitation rates for a natural resource. The regulator is modeled as an intermediary between current and future resource harvesters, rather than between producers and consumers, as in the traditional regulatory capture paradigm. When incumbent resource users have weak property rights, they have an incentive to pressure the regulator to allow resource extraction at an inefficiently rapid rate. In contrast, when property rights are strong, this incentive is minimized or eliminated. We build a theoretical model in which different property right institutions can be compared for their incentives to exert influence on the regulator. The main theoretical prediction -that stronger individual property rights will lead the regulator to choose more economically efficient extraction paths -is tested empirically with a novel panel data set from global fisheries. Exploiting the variation in timing of catch share implementation in our panel data, we find that regulators are significantly more conservative in managing resources for which strong individual property rights have been assigned to firms; this is especially pronounced for resources that have been overexploited historically.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了针对个体采掘企业的产权强度如何影响监管者在自然资源开采速率上的选择。与传统监管俘获范式中监管者位于生产者与消费者之间不同，这里的监管者被建模为当前与未来资源捕捞者之间的中介。当既有资源使用者的产权较弱时，他们有激励向监管者施压，要求以低效率的快速速度允许资源开采。相反，当产权较强时，这一激励被最小化甚至消除。我们构建了一个理论模型，用以比较不同产权制度对监管者施加影响的激励。主要的理论预测是：更强的个体产权将促使监管者选择经济上更有效率的开采路径。我们利用一个来自全球渔业的新颖面板数据集对这一预测进行了实证检验。利用面板数据中渔获份额制实施时间的差异，我们发现，对于已向企业分配了较强个体产权的资源，监管者的管理明显更为保守；这一效应在历史上曾被过度开采的资源上尤为突出。

title: The Political Economy of Fishery Reform
abstract: Despite compelling evidence that property rights–based management can improve the economic and ecological performance of fisheries, reform proposals are often met with political opposition. Moreover, the opposition sometimes comes from incumbent fishermen and fishing communities that would ostensibly gain the most from rent-enhancing reforms. We flesh out this puzzle by describing the political economy of past and present institutional changes in North America such as bans on fish traps, limited-entry regulations, and individual transferable quotas (ITQs). Our review identifies patterns of distributional concerns surrounding property rights; many of the same groups that opposed limits on entry and fish traps also oppose ITQs. We provide examples of how political opposition to ITQs is mollified by modifications in program design, although these design compromises may have efficiency costs. We conclude by pointing to the need for more research on equity-efficiency trade-offs and for greater attention to fishermen heterogeneity in economic analysis.
abstract_zh: 尽管有充分证据表明，基于产权的管理能够改善渔业的经济和生态绩效，但改革提议往往遭到政治反对。更有甚者，反对有时来自那些本应从增租改革中获益最多的现有渔民及渔业社区。我们通过描述北美过去和现在的制度变革（如禁用渔栅、限制准入以及个别可转让配额（ITQ））的政治经济学，阐明了这一谜题。我们的回顾揭示了围绕产权的分配性关切模式：许多反对限制准入和渔栅的群体，同样反对个别可转让配额。我们还举例说明，对个别可转让配额的政治反对如何通过项目设计的调整而得以缓和，尽管这些设计上的妥协可能带来效率成本。最后，我们指出，需要对公平与效率之间的权衡开展更多研究，并在经济分析中更加关注渔民的异质性。

venue: Climate Change Policies: Global Challenges and Future Prospects
abstract: Climate Change Policies sheds light on the foundations, design and effects of climate change policies. Written by leading international experts in the field, this book deals with the various economic effects from climate change policies introduced at national and international levels. It also expertly describes actual applications of climate change policies in the main emitting countries. This insightful study includes chapters on public policies and climate change impacts, adaptation, mitigation, effects on competitiveness, new technologies, distributional concerns, and the international dimension.
abstract_zh: 《气候变化政策》阐明了气候变化政策的基础、设计与效应。本书由该领域的国际知名专家撰写，探讨了在国家和国际层面实施的气候变化政策所产生的各种经济效应。书中还精辟地描述了主要排放国家气候变化政策的实际应用。这部深入的研究包括关于公共政策与气候变化影响、适应、减缓、对竞争力的影响、新技术、分配关切以及国际维度等主题的章节。

title: Redistricting and Polarization: Who Draws the Lines in California?
Who Pays a Price on Carbon?
abstract: We use the 2003 Consumer Expenditure Survey and emissions estimates from an input-output model to estimate the incidence of a price on carbon induced by a cap-and-trade program or carbon tax in the US context. We present results on how much difference income deciles pay for a carbon tax as well as which industries see the largest increase in costs due to a carbon tax. We illustrate the main determinant of the regressivity: consumption patterns for energy-intensive goods. We find that a policy targeting CO2 from energy consumption is more regressive than a price on all emissions. Furthermore, on a per-capita basis a carbon price is much more regressive than calculations at the household level. We discuss policy options to offset the adverse distributional effects of a carbon emissions policy.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2003年消费者支出调查以及投入产出模型的排放估计，估算了在美国背景下，由总量控制与交易计划或碳税所引致的碳价格的归宿。我们给出了不同收入十分位组为碳税所支付的差异，以及因碳税而成本增幅最大的行业的结果。我们说明了累退性的主要决定因素：能源密集型商品的消费模式。我们发现，针对能源消费所产生的二氧化碳（CO2）的政策，比针对所有排放的碳价格更具累退性。此外，以人均计算，碳价格的累退性远大于以家庭为单位的计算结果。我们讨论了用以抵消碳排放政策不利分配效应的政策选项。
